# MJ Bytech

> Premier Web Engineering & AI Innovation Agency. We design and build ultra-fast Next.js applications, AI-integrated platforms, and scalable web ecosystems for growing brands worldwide.

## Quick Facts
- **Organization Name**: MJ Bytech
- **Founder & CEO**: Ashish Kumar

- **Contact Email**: contact@mjbytech.com

- **Primary Tech Stack**: Next.js 15, React 19, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, OpenAI / AI APIs, Cloudflare, Vercel

## Core Capabilities & Services
1. **Next.js Web Engineering**: Custom enterprise-grade Next.js web applications, Server Components (RSC), static site generation (SSG), and incremental static regeneration (ISR) delivering sub-second load times and 95+ Google PageSpeed scores.
2. **Full-Stack MERN Development**: Scalable backend architectures, REST & GraphQL APIs, database modeling with MongoDB, and high-concurrency cloud infrastructure.
3. **Artificial Intelligence (AI) Integration**: Custom AI chatbots, LLM agent workflows, automated lead qualification, recommendation engines, and OpenAI API integrations.
4. **Technical SEO, AEO & GEO**: Search Engine Optimization, Answer Engine Optimization (for Google AI Overviews), Generative Engine Optimization (for Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Claude), and schema graph structuring.
5. **UI/UX Architecture & Conversion Design**: Clean modern interfaces, conversion rate optimization (CRO), interactive micro-animations, and mobile-first responsive systems.
